draft.text: You came in because your right wrist feels off and has been swollen, painful, and bruised since yesterday.
You slipped on stairs while doing laundry and landed on your right wrist.
We found that you have severe pain, swelling, and bruising in your right wrist, especially when you move it.
You also have tingling in your fingers, but no numbness or weakness.
It may be an injury from the fall, but we have not done any imaging tests to confirm the exact cause.
We will discuss the next steps to help you with your pain and swelling.
